selection.basis: Q00015/C00124 returned B00115 REWORK_REQUIRED. C117 accepted 10/10 semantic pairs and 11/11 guard arithmetic only as internally consistent, but rejected the source lineage: index38 was incorrectly de-duplicated onto index36 Release geometry; index206 used BC3/DXT5 Release while canonical inventory is RGBA; indices36/128 Release blobs were not hash-gated to canonical inventory. This task replaces those invalid source assumptions with current canonical inventory SHA-256/canvas identities and exact-source reacquisition gates.

canonical_source_policy.release_or_stock_role: semantic/reconstruction prior only; not canonical construction geometry unless exact canonical identity is independently proven

c117_rework_resolution.defect: B00115 used noncanonical Release source lineage and an invalid 36/38 de-duplication assumption.
resolved_now: Pins 4/4 exact current canonical user-HD SHA-256 identities, dimensions and decoded mode.
Retires B00115 Release-derived pixel rectangles/2px guards as canonical geometry.
Explicitly separates index36 and index38; their canonical SHA-256 identities and canvases differ.
Carries only current/C117-accepted semantic wording and expected occurrence counts.
Defines an exact hash-gated canonical source acquisition/decode/CLEAN_PLATE/v2 render pipeline for each asset.
Does not claim source pixels, header, orientation, masks, CLEAN_PLATE or candidate geometry before canonical bytes are available.
c117_rework_resolution.unresolved_dependency: Exact canonical DDS bytes matching the four inventory SHA-256 identities are not present at their queue paths in current Git HEAD.

material_advance.description: Makes the next safe producer step deterministic: acquire/import only the exact current canonical user-HD bytes, reject wrong-source hashes before decode, treat 36 and 38 as distinct sources, and rebuild masks/CLEAN_PLATE/safe bboxes from canonical pixels rather than Release geometry.

canonical_reacquisition_gate: Acquire/import the exact canonical user-HD DDS matching canonical_sha256.
Verify SHA-256 equality before interpreting header or pixels; filename suffix dimensions are not authoritative.
Read actual DDS header and preserve source width/height/format/compression/mips/alpha behavior.
Determine raw/readable orientation from this exact canonical source; do not inherit Release geometry/orientation as canonical proof.
Measure effect-inclusive English source bboxes from the exact canonical pixels.
Build source-removal and protected-non-text masks only from exact canonical pixels.
Create CLEAN_PLATE and require zero changes outside removal mask, zero protected-art changes, zero alpha change outside mask, no residue/seams/boxes.
Derive first-pass-v2 candidate_safe_bbox with default 2px inset from measured canonical geometry.
Render Korean deterministically at native resolution; refit only by fresh render, never by shrinking a flattened text raster.
Run exact-crop ENGLISH SOURCE vs KOREAN CANDIDATE proof and zero-pixel containment before static promotion.
Keep runtime_validation UNTESTED until a real in-game test exists.
